stem: The standard deviation of the heights of adult males is 7.2 cm. The mean height of a sample of 200 adult males is found to be 176 cm.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Calculate a 97.5% confidence interval for the mean height of adult males.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State a necessary condition for the calculation in part (i) to be valid.
